source.body:
**Decision needed:** approve the positioning below as the starting point for `docs/STRATEGY.md` (I'll open it as a PR you edit and merge). **Recommendation: approve.**

## Problem / opportunity
We need a shared, written bet so proposals stop being ad hoc. The first competitor pass shows a clear gap. Every existing product is either a **transaction/listing tool** (Algrano, Cropster Hub, Beanstock, greensquare), a **seller back-office** (CropConex, Cropster Origin) or **paid market data** (StoneX). None is the buyer's or broker's own independent workspace that combines market context with their relationships, samples and cuppings.

## Proposed content (what Z will see)
- **Vision:** the independent sourcing workspace for specialty coffee buyers and brokers, with market intelligence built in.
- **Positioning:** neutral (we don't sell coffee or take a commission), so we complement marketplaces instead of competing on liquidity.
- **Sourcing jobs-to-be-done:** find & vet suppliers → sample & cup → price & negotiate → contract & ship → track & re-buy, with which segments share each step.
- **First segment:** solo buyers/brokers and small roasters (<50 t/yr), starting with you. They're under-served by enterprise-priced tools, and the shared core (CRM + cupping + price context) scales up to importers.
- **Quality bars ("best" = measurable):** e.g. offline capture works on a farm; any offer can be checked against a sourced benchmark in under 30 s; every price shows its source and age.
- **Current bets:** Sourcing CRM, Field mode, Offer check, pre-trip hosting.
- **Moat:** unique joins (relationships × cuppings × live market data) and Costa Rica ground truth from your trip.
- Rejected alternative: positioning as a marketplace. It needs liquidity and capital, and Algrano and Cropster already own it.

## Out of scope
Monetization (later, its own proposal) and pricing pages.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] PR with `docs/STRATEGY.md` covering the sections above, each claim linked to `agent/research`
- [ ] Your edits incorporated; merged only by you

## Size: S (one run)

## Research behind it
[agent/research/2026-10-15-competitor-landscape.md](https://github.com/zack-hum/coffee-intelligence-v1.1/blob/docs/research-2026-10-15/agent/research/2026-10-15-competitor-landscape.md). Next research will cover segment workflows (roasters solo → enterprise, importers, cafes) to firm up the segment choice.
